name: com.gamecore.gameplay.contracts
description: Tiny Unity-free contracts shared by the gameplay plugin library (P1.1): authoring identity (AuthoringIds, IAuthoredObject, IDefinitionAsset), the authoring metadata attributes plugins annotate definitions and tools with, stable slot/route/schema id derivation (SlotNames, GameplayIds), units and scales (mm, mrad, ms), the presentation binder and residency interfaces, the little-endian gameplay payload codec and the gameplay diagnostic codes.
